name: Recipes — create a recipe and view its detail page

planSteps.description: Enter 'testsprite@herbary.test' in the Email field and 'Testsprite123!' in the Password field, then click the 'Log In' button
Wait until the nav bar shows 'My Recipes', then click 'My Recipes'
Enter a unique name like 'TS Calm Tea <random digits>' in the Name field
Type 'chamomile' into 'Ingredient 1', click '+ Add Ingredient', and type 'lemon balm' into 'Ingredient 2'
Type 'Steep both herbs in hot water for ten minutes.' into Instructions and '10' into Prep Time
The browser navigates to /my-recipes and the list contains the recipe name that was entered with '2 ingredients · 10 min'
The recipe detail page shows the recipe name as a heading, '10 minutes', and an Ingredients list containing 'chamomile' and 'lemon balm'
